eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL DANGER WARNING for the following counties or areas: Douglas, WA; at 12:34 PM on AUG 15, 2023 Effective until 3:34 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Douglas County Sheriff Office is asking the public to shelter in place or evacuate to the Bridgeport Gym if you ware within 400 yards of the 900 block of Foster Avenue in Bridgeport WA. Deputies are working with ARMY EOD to remove explosives in the area. For safe removal this is expected to take several hours. This concludes this message from the Douglas County Sheriffs Office
